info.title: Elgarde API
info.description:
The Elgarde API. Everything under **`/v1`** is a free, public, no-auth tier —
no key, no sign-up, CORS open to any origin, rate-limited per IP:

- `GET /v1/checklist` — the adaptive pre-purchase inspection checklist in
  English, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian and French.
- `GET /v1/defects` — curated model-specific known weak points; pass facts
  about the car (`year`, `fuel`, `gearbox`, `engineCode`, `vin`, …) to keep
  only the ones that can apply to its engine and gearbox.
- `GET /v1/defects/{defect_id}` — the full dossier behind one known defect:
  applicability per engine and gearbox, how to inspect, repair, sources and
  prevalence.
- `GET /v1/catalog` — every published defect dossier, for syncing.
- `POST /v1/score` — roll a sheet of 1–5 answers into an overall verdict.
- `GET /v1/vin/{vin}` — VIN decode over the free NHTSA vPIC dataset.

The underlying data and the scoring specification are open
([ElgardeCom/elgarde](https://github.com/ElgardeCom/elgarde),
CC-BY-4.0). Please keep the attribution that every response carries, and cache
results rather than re-fetching static content.

Elgarde is a self-service checklist, not a certified, mechanical or legal
inspection. Every other route on this service belongs to the Elgarde app and
requires authentication.

get.description:
What this tier serves, which canon version it is on, and how to credit
it. `defectsRelease` is the version of the known-defects dossiers and
`catalog` links to their list. Free, no key, no auth.

The checklist for a car: base groups, the fuel-specific module, and the
known-defect group when the make/model matches a curated rule.

get.summary: Known weak points for a make and model
get.description:
Curated, model-specific things to check — the DQ200 dry clutch, the
PureTech wet belt, the N47 chain. Empty when nothing is curated for that
model yet; that is not a statement that the model has no known issues.

**Without** any fact parameter the list is exactly the v2 list, each entry
enriched with a v3 `status` worked out from make and model alone.
**With** facts (`year`, `fuel`, `gearbox`, `engineCode`, `vin`, …) defects
that cannot apply are moved out (to `excluded` when `includeExcluded=true`),
and `questions` lists what to ask to settle the `possible` ones.

get.summary: Full dossier for one known defect
get.description:
Everything behind one defect: applicability per engine and gearbox,
symptoms, how to inspect, repair and cost, every source with its archive
copy, and prevalence — a measured figure with its confidence grade, or an
explicit statement that no reliable figure exists.

post.description:
Roll a sheet of 1–5 answers up into group scores and one overall verdict.
A failed critical item clamps the verdict down — see the scoring spec.

get.summary: Decode a VIN (free NHTSA vPIC data)
get.description:
Normalise NHTSA vPIC output into a usable shape. US-centric and thin on
European models — partial results with nulls are normal, not an error.
Cached for 24h; please cache on your side too.

DefectsRelease.title: DefectsRelease
DefectsRelease.description:
Version of the v3 defects data. Separate from `canonVersion`, which
stays `{checklist: int, defects: int}`.

defectsDisclaimer.title: Defectsdisclaimer
defectsDisclaimer.description: The canonical known-defects disclaimer, in `lang`. Show it next to any defect text you reproduce.

reviewStatus.title: Reviewstatus
reviewStatus.description: pending: not checked yet. source_verified: the source was opened and the claims, dates and figures compared with it (automated check, no human sign-off). approved: signed off by an Elgarde reviewer.

Prevalence.title: Prevalence
Prevalence.description:
Either a figure (with population and confidence grade) or an explicit
`noReliableFigure` with the reason. Every field is always present.

ScoreRequest.title: ScoreRequest
ScoreRequest.description:
Scores keyed by checklist item id. 1–5 rates the item; -1 marks it not
applicable, -2 not inspected; omit an item to leave it unanswered.
